QuestInfo.name: [Kanna] Back on Your Feet
QuestInfo.0: After reclaiming Honnou-ji, Princess Sakuno requests a word.
QuestInfo.1: After reclaiming Honnou-ji, Princess Sakuno requests a word.
QuestInfo.2: Princess Sakuno asked Kanna to become her vassal once again. When they agreed, Kanna felt a portion of their lost power finally returning. Princess Sakuno created an earth vein at Honnou-ji and gave them the Return skill.
